entries.title: Iconoclasts

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best archive route because it has the complete game with native PC capture/settings flexibility. The Linux, macOS, PlayStation, Switch, Xbox, and Luna versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Iconoclasts on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or content-expanded edition is documented.
